sentence: This project builds an incisionless ultrasound device to treat brain disorders by targeting the dorsal anterior cingulate cortex.
This project develops inhibitors of a deubiquitinase that helps Ewing sarcoma grow, a rare pediatric cancer.
This project tests whether a small molecule called ifetroban, which blocks the thromboxane-prostanoid receptor, reduces radiation-induced pulmonary fibrosis.
This project uses molecular and functional imaging to understand how tumor microenvironments make prostate cancer resistant to immune checkpoint inhibitors.
This project develops a platform based on interfacial protein self-assembly to increase the functionality of biomedical and biological surfaces.
This project organizes core services, such as genomics, cell culture and metabolic imaging, that support nutrition and obesity research.
This project tries to find out how molecular chaperones control the formation of improper protein shapes that can cause human diseases.
This project tries to find out why disrupting a transcription factor kills rhabdoid tumor cells.
This project provides flow cytometry, cell sorting and cellular imaging services to help researchers with single cell analysis.
This project tests how harmful tau and a defect in mitochondrial complex I are connected in neurodegenerative diseases.
This project uses genomic analysis and knockout mouse models to find genes in osteoblasts and osteoclasts that affect bone mineral density and fracture.
This project studies whether infection with Helicobacter bacteria is linked to liver cancer in African Americans and whites.
This project tests a biomarker that helps predict outcomes in adolescents and young adults with sarcomas, including Ewing sarcoma.
This project builds a protein microarray to study how pairs of proteins interact and respond to drugs.
This project uses genetic testing, cardiac imaging and heart tissue biopsy to create diagnostic tests for genetic and inflammatory causes of heart disease.
This project builds a 3D model platform that monitors neural network organization across the surface of brain organoids.
This project creates statistical methods to handle errors and missing data in electronic health records.
This project tries to find out how Amyloid-Beta disrupts the nano-scale organization of synaptic proteins and how that relates to the loss of synapses.
This project tries to find out why activating a transcription factor blocks the growth of non small cell lung cancer.
This project studies how a deubiquitinase lets Ewing sarcoma, an aggressive pediatric bone cancer, bypass oncogene-induced replication stress.
